description: Loop-engineered completion: Phase 0 UI + Reputation/Evidence moat + pilot essentials. One story per iteration. No Instagram/WhatsApp/Facebook cold automation.

userStories.title: Actions List API controls on outbox jobs
userStories.description: As an operator, I want Approve/Reject/Snooze/Rerun on pending jobs so that Outbox works as an Actions queue.
acceptanceCriteria: Tenant-scoped endpoints or existing outbox routes support approve, reject, snooze (with until), and rerun-AI for a pending job
Guardian block-level risk cannot be bypassed by approve-without-edit when policy requires HITL
Unauthorized cross-tenant job access returns 404/403
Tests pass for happy path + tenant isolation + snooze
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reuse jobs/outbox as system of record. Do not create a parallel Actions table unless unavoidable.

userStories.title: Actions List UI on Pending Approvals / Outbox
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a clear Actions screen so I can clear the queue with verbs.
acceptanceCriteria: Outbox/Pending Approvals shows action rows: contact, company, campaign, type, short reason, status
Buttons: Approve, Reject, Snooze, Edit, Rerun AI (wired to US-001)
Loading, empty, and error states exist
Verify in browser or dashboard build succeeds with smoke navigation
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Reasoning panel API fields on job + prospect
userStories.description: As an operator, I want evidence, guardian risk, and trace id returned on job/prospect payloads so the UI can show why.
acceptanceCriteria: Job/outbox detail includes signal_stack evidence, guardian score/issues/fixes, openinference_trace_id when present
Prospect/contact detail includes stack score + evidence list
Tenant-scoped; tests cover presence after 2-signal simulate + plan
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Data may already exist — expose consistently in API responses.

userStories.title: Reasoning panel UI on Outbox + Prospect
userStories.description: As a founder demoing, I want to SEE stack evidence, Guardian fixes, and trace id without using curl.
acceptanceCriteria: Outbox/Action detail shows evidence citations, guardian score + issues/fixes, trace id
Prospect view shows stack evidence + score
HITL reason shown when forced by Guardian block
dashboard build passes
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Campaign UI for min_signal_stack + simulate signals
userStories.description: As a demo operator, I want to set min_signal_stack and simulate signals from the UI with an honest label.
acceptanceCriteria: Campaign create/edit exposes min_signal_stack control
Campaign detail has Simulate signals control labeled as demo/ingest (not fake live radar)
1 signal with min=2 creates no prospect; 2 distinct signals creates prospect (UI path)
Tests or e2e smoke covers API; UI build passes
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: LLM unavailable honest banner on template fallback
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a clear banner when drafts fall back to templates so the demo is not misleading.
acceptanceCriteria: When personalizer uses template fallback, job/UI surfaces source=template or equivalent honest label
When LLM succeeds with evidence, draft path does not show template banner
Tests pass for both paths (mocked LLM)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Founder has API keys; still handle quota failure honestly.

userStories.title: Hard evidence gate before dispatch
userStories.description: As a domain owner, I want stacked campaigns to refuse dispatch without fresh evidence so we do not send ungrounded AI spam.
acceptanceCriteria: When campaign min_signal_stack >= 2, dispatch/plan fails closed or forces HITL block if evidence missing/stale
Guardian receives grounding terms from evidence when present
Tests cover: with evidence allowed path; without evidence blocked/forced HITL
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: MOAT: evidence-gated sending. Build on Signal Stack E2E already on branch.

userStories.title: Reputation snapshot service per mailbox
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a reputation snapshot (health, bounce proxy, sends today, pause reason) so reputation is a first-class asset.
acceptanceCriteria: Service or endpoint returns per-mailbox: health status, emails_sent_today, bounce-related signals available, pause/unsafe reason
Tenant-scoped; unhealthy mailbox excluded from smart dispatch (no regression)
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: MOAT: Reputation OS foundation. Reuse mailbox_health + bounce_detector.

userStories.title: Reputation dashboard UI
userStories.description: As an operator/agency, I want a Reputation page so I can see which mailboxes are safe before scaling.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard page or Operations section lists mailboxes with health, sends today, risk badges
Unsafe/paused mailboxes visually distinct
Empty/loading/error states
dashboard build passes
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Agency proof pack includes deliverability health
userStories.description: As an agency operator, I want proof packages to include deliverability/reputation summary plus COGS/meetings so clients trust results.
acceptanceCriteria: Proof/ROI package endpoint includes mailbox health summary + meetings + COGS/margin + trace ids
Tenant-scoped; no cross-tenant leakage
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: MOAT: agency proof. Extend existing proof package if present.

userStories.title: Reply Brain next-action drafts
userStories.description: As an operator, I want inbound replies classified into next Actions (positive, OOO, postpone, unsubscribe, meeting cancel) with drafts.
acceptanceCriteria: Classifier paths create/update an Action/job with type + draft + reason for at least: positive, ooo, unsubscribe
Actions appear in Actions List (US-002)
HITL by default
Tests pass for classification → action creation
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Tenant knowledge block injection
userStories.description: As a tenant admin, I want a knowledge block used in personalization so drafts follow our offer/voice.
acceptanceCriteria: API to create/update a tenant-scoped knowledge string/block
Personalizer receives knowledge when present
Tests pass with knowledge influencing prompt/input (mock LLM ok)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Scoped Autopilot toggle on campaign
userStories.description: As an operator, I want an explicit campaign Autopilot toggle (default off) so autonomy is never silent.
acceptanceCriteria: Campaign has autopilot boolean default false stored + returned by API
When autopilot false, sends require approval
When autopilot true, eligible jobs may auto-send EXCEPT Guardian block which always forces HITL
UI toggle present; honest copy about risk
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Clarify/replace silent 50-send trust ramp behavior in docs + code path.

userStories.title: Campaign soft-stop and hard-stop
userStories.description: As an operator, I want soft-stop and hard-stop so I can halt outreach safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Soft-stop: no new sequences; document in-flight behavior
Hard-stop: no further sends for campaign jobs
API + UI controls
Tests pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Docs truth table + Phase 0 PR notes
userStories.description: As a founder, I want honest docs of Real vs Simulate vs Prototype so we never overclaim.
acceptanceCriteria: docs/SIGNAL_STACK_AND_MOAT_STATUS.md exists with Real/Partial/Prototype labels
States simulate-only ingestion honestly
States no cold IG/WA/FB
